summary: Verified login bug fix end-to-end. Backend auth tests (login/register/me/logout/duplicate/invalid) all pass. Frontend Playwright test confirms: admin@salesmis.com/Admin@123 login succeeds, navigates from /login to / (Overview dashboard), sidebar shows 'Admin' at bottom, localStorage contains access_token (209 chars), page reload preserves session, and logout clears token and redirects to /login. Dual auth (httpOnly cookies + Bearer localStorage) works. 19/20 backend tests pass (1 unrelated dataset upload test fails because /tmp/sample.xls is missing — not a code bug).

minor.issue: Backend test test_upload_dataset requires /tmp/sample.xls which is not present in the environment. Not a code bug — test data setup issue. Existing dataset outward.xls (8563 rows) is uploaded and analytics endpoints all work.

issues: Console warnings: recharts 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic, does not break UI. Consider setting minHeight on ResponsiveContainer parents.

action_items: (Optional) Fix recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height=-1 warnings on Overview dashboard by ensuring parent has explicit min dimensions.
(Optional) Provide /tmp/sample.xls fixture or refactor test_upload_dataset to skip when fixture missing.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend/CORS: allow_origin_regex='.*' + allow_credentials=True is functionally permissive but works via same-origin ingress. Fine for preview.

Auth: dual-mode (httpOnly cookie + Bearer token from localStorage) is implemented cleanly; api.js interceptor attaches Authorization from localStorage. AuthContext saves/clears access_token appropriately.
Backend /api/auth/me and /api/auth/login exclude password_hash and _id from responses — verified.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing outward.xls dataset (8563 rows) already active.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login bug fix verified. Dual auth (cookie + Bearer/localStorage) works. If you need to add /tmp/sample.xls for upload tests, copy a small .xls file to /tmp/sample.xls before running pytest.
rca of the issue: Original 'network error' was caused by browser dropping/blocking httpOnly cookies in this preview URL context, leaving the frontend without any auth after /api/auth/login succeeded. Fix: backend now also returns access_token in the JSON response body; frontend stores it in localStorage and axios attaches Authorization: Bearer header for subsequent requests. This bypasses cookie dependency. Verified working end-to-end.
